paper.title_en: Gravitational Waves From an Entangled SO(3) Cosmic String Network
paper.abstract_en: Discrete non-Abelian symmetries such as $\mathrm{A_4}$ are widely used in models of lepton flavor to explain neutrino mass hierarchy and their large mixing. If such a symmetry arises from the spontaneous breaking of a continuous group, cosmic strings can form. We study the breaking $\mathrm{SO}(3)\to \mathrm{A_4}$, for which the strings are classified by the non-Abelian group $π_1(\mathrm{SO}(3)/\mathrm{A_4})\cong \mathrm{T}'$, the binary tetrahedral group. Because the string fluxes do not commute, colliding strings may reconnect, pass through each other, or become joined by a bridge whose flux can belong to a different string network. We derive the probabilities of these outcomes directly from the group structure; in network models they are usually treated as free parameters. Including them in a multi-network velocity-dependent one-scale model, we find that the correlation length of the networks decreases and their energy density increases relative to Abelian $\mathrm{U}(1)$ strings of the same tension. The resulting stochastic gravitational-wave background is enhanced by up to nearly three orders of magnitude, showing that the algebraic structure of $π_1$ leaves a direct imprint on the gravitational-wave spectrum.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文从非阿贝尔拓扑结构出发，直接导出非阿贝尔宇宙弦网络的碰撞与桥接概率，并将其纳入多网络速度依赖单尺度模型，预言随机引力波背景最高可增强近三个数量级。理论推导清晰、与PTA关注的随机引力波背景直接相关，虽为极新预印本（3天，0引用，属中性），仍值得点开细读。
decision.title_zh: 纠缠的SO(3)宇宙弦网络产生的引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 诸如 $\mathrm{A_4}$ 之类的离散非阿贝尔对称性被广泛用于轻子味模型，以解释中微子质量等级及其大混合。若此类对称性来自连续群的自发破缺，则可能形成宇宙弦。我们研究 $\mathrm{SO}(3)\to \mathrm{A_4}$ 的破缺，对此类弦由非阿贝尔群 $π_1(\mathrm{SO}(3)/\mathrm{A_4})\cong \mathrm{T}'$（二元四面体群）分类。由于弦的磁通量不对易，相互碰撞的弦可能重新连接、彼此穿过，或通过一座桥相连，而该桥的磁通量可能属于另一个弦网络。我们直接从群结构导出这些结果的概率；在网络模型中，这些概率通常被当作自由参数处理。将其纳入多网络速度依赖单尺度模型后，我们发现，与相同张力下的阿贝尔 $\mathrm{U}(1)$ 弦相比，网络的关联长度减小、能量密度增大。由此产生的随机引力波背景最高增强近三个数量级，表明 $π_1$ 的代数结构在引力波谱上留下了直接的印记。
